items.headline: Hayes throws 4 TD passes, Singleton catches 3 of them, and Tulsa routs Charlotte 42-14
items.description: — Baylor Hayes threw four touchdown passes, three of them to Oran Singleton Jr., and Tulsa blew past Charlotte 42-14 on Saturday.

items.headline: Hayes leads Tulsa in another offensive eruption, beating Florida Atlantic 38-21
items.description: — Baylor Hayes threw for 309 yards and two touchdowns and Tulsa never trailed in a 38-21 win over Florida Atlantic on Saturday night to become eligible for a bowl game.
